task_summary: Implemented direct drag-and-drop defense scheduling on release (bypassing confirmation modals), overlap collision detection with warning toast rejection, optimistic UI updates with automatic rollback, 30-minute standard duration quantum (36px flex layout with strict leading-[1.2], truncate, and hover tooltips), comprehensive team leader display across all cards and views, universal adoption of 'Capstone' terminology, and strict designated-person-only Action Done Matrix (ADM) signatories via backend middleware verifyAdmSignatoryRole and client capability gating. Verified with 12 client scheduling tests, 6 client ADM tests, 15 server tests, 0 route mismatches, 60/60 agentic validation checks, pristine workspace guardrails, and full 8-screenshot Playwright visual audit across light and dark desktop and mobile viewports.
